idea-plugin.name: IronBase
idea-plugin.description:
An AI coding agent that starts from your architecture — ported here from the VS Code extension of the same name.

This build is a skeleton, not a full port. Chat with a connected Claude account works end to end: sign in with an API key, send a message, watch the reply stream in. The rest of the VS Code extension — planning and writing code, the tool trace, checkpoint and undo, the project indexer, the architecture review — has not been ported yet. See the plugin's README for what is and is not here.
